QuestInfo.name: Chiefs of El Nath
QuestInfo.0: You heard that mysterious voice again. Find Dances with Balrog, the Warrior Job Instructor, and receive his advice.
QuestInfo.1: Dances with Balrog says that you can become an even stronger Warrior. He's sent you to the Chief's Residence in El Nath.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Tylus, the Warrior Elder, at the Chief's Residence.
